phone.title: Sign in
phone.subtitle: Use your Telegram account to continue
phone.label: Phone number (+country code)
phone.terms: By continuing, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms>
phone.deliveryTip: Telegram delivers the code to its app first. SMS or a call is offered only when Telegram allows it.

qr.title: Quick Sign in with QR
qr.subtitle: Scan with your phone or open the Telegram app
qr.scanInstruction: In Telegram: Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device
qr.expired: QR code expired. Click to refresh.
qr.openedTelegramToast: Opening Telegram... Please confirm the login request in the app.
qr.openedOneTapToast: Opening Telegram... Tap Confirm to sign in.
qr.openAppError: Could not open Telegram app. Please scan the QR code manually.

otp.title: Verify your number
otp.subtitle: We sent a code to <phone>{{phone}}</phone>
otp.floodWait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}

delivery.appTitle: Code sent to your Telegram app
delivery.appStep1: Open your official Telegram app (iOS / Android / Desktop)
delivery.appStep2: Look for a message from Telegram (the account with the blue shield icon)
delivery.appStep3: The code will be a 5-digit number in that chat
delivery.appDesc: Open Telegram and look for the chat named Telegram. The login code is a service message there.
delivery.openAppToast: Opening Telegram... Check the chat named Telegram for your code.
delivery.smsDesc: We sent an SMS text message with your login code to {{phone}}.
delivery.emailDesc: Telegram sent a verification code to {{email}}.
delivery.callDesc: Telegram is calling {{phone}} to dictate your verification code.
delivery.fragmentDesc: Open Fragment with your wallet to view the login code.

resend.viaSms: Didn't get it? Send code via SMS
resend.viaCall: Didn't get it? Call me with the code
resend.viaFragment: Didn't get it? Get code via Fragment
resend.notAvailable: Telegram isn't offering another delivery method. Use the code already sent.
resend.unavailableToast: Can't resend via SMS. Check your Telegram app for the code.

otp.tryQr: No code received? Try QR code login instead

emailSetup.title: Verify your email
emailSetup.subtitle: Telegram asks you to add a login email before sending the code.
emailSetup.codeSubtitle: Enter the code Telegram sent to {{email}}.

password.title: Two-Step Verification
password.subtitle: Your account has an additional cloud password
password.label: Cloud password

diagnostics.copied: Login diagnostics copied (no code or full phone number).

toasts.codeSentApp: Verification code sent to your Telegram app!
toasts.codeSentSms: Verification code sent via SMS to your phone!
toasts.codeSentEmail: Verification code sent to your email!
toasts.emailSetupRequired: Telegram asks you to verify an email before sending the login code.

errors.sendCodeFailed: Failed to send code. Make sure your country code is included.
errors.phoneNumberInvalid: The phone number is invalid. Make sure to include the '+' and country code (e.g. +91XXXXXXXXXX).
errors.phoneNumberBanned: This phone number has been banned by Telegram.
errors.phoneNumberFlood: You asked for the code too many times. Please wait before trying again, or use QR login.
errors.phonePasswordFlood: You have tried logging in too many times. Please wait before trying again.
errors.phoneFlood: Too many attempts with this phone number. Please wait before trying again, or scan the QR code to log in.
errors.tooManyCodeRequests: You've requested 3 codes in the last hour. To protect your account, use QR login or wait {{count}} seconds.
errors.sendCodeUnavailable: Telegram isn't offering another delivery method. Check your Telegram app for the code, or use QR login.
errors.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please check and try again.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.resendFailed: Failed to resend code. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.floodWait_one: Too many attempts. Please wait {{count}} second before trying again.
errors.floodWait_other: Too many attempts. Please wait {{count}} seconds before trying again.
errors.floodWaitFewSeconds: Too many attempts. Please wait a few seconds before trying again.
errors.incorrectPassword: Incorrect password. Please check and try again.
errors.incorrectCloudPassword: Incorrect cloud password. Please try again.
errors.bootstrapFailed: Failed to bootstrap storage channel. Please retry.
errors.apiIdPublishedFlood: Telegram blocked the built-in API ID because it is publicly known. Add your own VITE_TELEGRAM_API_ID and VITE_TELEGRAM_API_HASH to a .env file (from my.telegram.org), rebuild the app, or use 1-tap/QR login.
errors.signUpRequired: This phone number isn't registered on Telegram. Create an account in the official Telegram app first.
errors.authRestart: Telegram restarted the authentication. Please try again.
errors.sessionInvalid: The session is invalid. Please sign in again.
errors.serverMigrate: Telegram is redirecting to the correct server. Please try again.
errors.networkError: Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.twoStepRequired: Two-step verification is required. Please enter your password.
errors.emailNotAllowed: Telegram won't accept this email address. Try a different one.
errors.emailVerifyExpired: The email verification expired. Please request a new email code.
errors.emailCodeInvalid: Invalid email verification code. Please check and try again.
errors.emailVerifyFailed: Could not verify this email. Please try again.
